entry.title: PotentialPatina 1.1.0
entry.summary: **PotentialPatina 1.1.0** - **Three looks.** A new default look, **Print Plate** (a warm printed panel), plus **Night Rack** (dark rack unit) and **Colour Block** (flat, big type), each in PotentialPatina's own colour. Pick one with the big LOOK keys on the SETTINGS page; it shows the next time the plugin loads (take it off and add it again, or load your project again), and it is remembered on your MPC for every project. - Sound, controls and saved projects are unchanged. entry.title: PotentialPatina 1.0.4
entry.summary: **PotentialPatina 1.0.4**: name tidy-up. - The title on the plugin's page now reads **PotentialPatina**, the same as in the MPC's plugin list (it was in all capitals). entry.title: PotentialPatina 1.0.2
entry.summary: **PotentialPatina 1.0.2**, the first public release. A retro-colour insert effect: vinyl and tape noise, wobble, drive, bit-crush, tone and room, all set with one MAGNITUDE knob and nine subtle presets. See the [README](https://github.com/PotentialBreakfast/mpc-vst-potentialpatina#readme) for details and limitations. **Download** `PotentialPatina-1.0.2-mpc-armv7.zip` below.
